title: The Future of AI: From Chatbots to a Digital Workforce
tagline: How AI agents could reshape work, discovery, and opportunity.
excerpt: Explore the forces shaping AI, the limits behind the hype, and practical ways people and businesses can prepare.
heroAlt: Illustration of a human-directed workflow connecting an AI assistant, tools, and specialist agents.
takeaways: AI is expanding from generating answers to carrying out supervised workflows.
Infrastructure, reliability, and human decisions will shape how widely it is adopted.
Build domain expertise and AI fluency together, while keeping accountability clear.

title: Will Humans Truly Be Replaced by Robots?
tagline: Understanding task automation, changing jobs, and the human role.
excerpt: Separate demonstrations from deployment, examine the economics of automation, and understand why tasks and whole jobs change differently.
heroAlt: Illustration of a human and a robot sharing a workspace, with tasks divided between them.
takeaways: Automating a task is different from eliminating an entire job or occupation.
Cost, reliability, and physical environments constrain robot adoption.
Employment forecasts describe possible transitions, not individual career guarantees.

title: How to Write Prompts That Get the Output You Want
tagline: Clear instructions, useful examples, and a repeatable way to improve results.
excerpt: A practical guide with a six-part framework, before-and-after examples, a reusable template, and an output-checking checklist.
heroAlt: Illustration of role, task, context, and format flowing into a clear prompt and a reviewed response.
takeaways: Specify the task, audience, inputs, format, and constraints before asking for an answer.
Use examples and structured sections when a request is complex.
Evaluate and refine the result; even a careful prompt cannot guarantee perfect accuracy.
